Week 38 | Tuesday 22nd September 2026 Market Insight
By Nikos Tagoulis, Head of Research Department
China's steel sector has returned to focus following the recent call
by the China Iron and Steel Association (CISA) for domestic pro-
ducers to curb output. The move points to a growing need to align
steel production more closely with domestic demand and could
also affect China's iron ore import requirements. The sector's challenges remain closely linked to headwinds in Chi-
na's domestic economy.
